Good evening, passengers. This is a boarding announcement for flight 447 to Chicago. We are now boarding rows twenty to thirty at gate B12. Please have your boarding pass and your passport ready. Passengers with a layover in Chicago should collect their luggage at baggage claim before customs. Thank you.

Attention, please. Flight 862 to Toronto is delayed by one hour because of the weather. The new departure time is nine fifteen, and the gate has changed to A7 in terminal one. Passengers on a round trip to Toronto do not need to check in again. We are sorry for the delay and we thank you for your patience.

First, the officer asks for the passport. Then she asks about the purpose of the trip. After that, Thiago says how long he is staying. Next, the officer asks where he is staying in the city. Finally, she stamps the passport and welcomes him.
